name: Dracarabo
look: a beetle whose great horn is an orange dragon's skull with jagged jaws, a small brown face with a yellow beak and green eyes, a yellow flame-striped abdomen and six spiky dark legs with yellow claws
entry: The horn on its head grows into the shape of a dragon's skull, jaws and all. It charges with the jaws wide open, and the snap when they close can be heard right across the savanna.
how: Evolve Ovarupa at level 42. It learns Dragon Rush when it evolves.
